newsitem.title: USA: Quaker Q3 helped by foreign tax benefits.
newsitem.headline: Quaker Q3 helped by foreign tax benefits.

text.p: Quaker Oats Co said Thursday its earnings for the third quarter were boosted by about $7.2 million, or $0.05 a share, due to foreign tax benefits.

Earlier, Quaker reported net earnings for the third quarter of $133.0 million, or $0.98 a share, which included a $133.6 million pretax gain, or $0.59 a share, on the sale of its frozen foods business. The quarter also included $23.0 million in pretax restructuring charges, or $0.14 a sahre.
Excluding the items, Quaker's third quarter earnings were $0.53 a share. A year ago, it earned $61.5 million or $0.45 a share.

The effective tax rate for the quarter was 39.8 percent, reflecting the foreign tax benefits. Excluding this and the tax effects of the frozen food divestiture and restructuring charges, the effective tax rate for the quarter would have been 41.0 percent, Quaker said.
Interest expense in the quarter declined to $25.6 million from $28.7 million, reflecting a reduction of about $200 million in overall debt to about $1.4 billion.
